steps.en: Install the CLI and start your local app
steps.zh: 安装命令行，启动本地应用

steps.en: Configure app or gateway authentication; verify unauthenticated requests are denied
steps.zh: 先配置应用或网关认证，验证未认证请求被拒

steps.en: Only then add the protected listener as a route
steps.zh: 检查通过后，才为受保护端口创建路由

steps.en: Immediately exposes the route publicly and prints its HTTPS URL
steps.zh: 立即公开路由，打印 HTTPS 地址

steps.en: Share the URL with intended users; sharing is not access control
steps.zh: 把地址分享给预期用户；分享不构成访问控制

steps.en: Relays visitor TLS to your machine, then forwards locally decrypted bytes
steps.zh: 把访客 TLS 送到本机，解密后转发字节

value.en: Reach an authenticated local app over HTTPS while retaining its TLS key locally
value.zh: 从公网 HTTPS 访问已设认证的本地应用，私钥仍留本机
